items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: He worked with Slim at Billy Berg's later on.

ctx.x: He worked with Slim at Billy Berg's later on. And I'll tell you when he first came later; to California later...

Billy Berg was quite a man. He really was a nightclub owner. He knew how to do it, you know. He kept great entertainment on his stage. And he kept the broadcasts coming out every night. Every night, whoever was there would broadcast thirty minutes every night. And no cover, no minimum, and everything was just beautiful -- all the bartenders were beautiful... In fact, we used to play on Tuesday nights on the jam sessions, and on Sunday afternoons on the jam sessions. We'd broadcast on Tuesday nights, you know,…
